description: The named mode a flow is in (`editing`, `submitting`). Exactly one at a time, so impossible combinations of booleans disappear.
Extended, quantitative data of a machine (form values, results). Updated only with `assign` in actions.
A predicate that must pass for a transition to be taken. Named guards are declared in `setup({ guards })` and checked by `snapshot.can(event)`.
Work started when a state is entered and stopped when it is left, e.g. `fromPromise`. Results arrive as `onDone` (`event.output`) and `onError` (`event.error`).
XState v5 entry point that registers named actors, guards, actions and delays, then builds the machine with `.createMachine(config)`.
Returns a copy of the machine with some implementations replaced, used to inject fake actors in tests.
Run a machine without re-rendering on every snapshot, subscribing components to selected slices only.
